citations.claim: FavoritesDlg resolves a session and connects the selected host.
main constructs JFTPApplication; constructor configures preferences, constructs and shows JFTP, creates a session.
FTPSession creates local/remote panes and status window.
Connection work creates a SwingWorker, reflectively loads FTP classes, then calls client.connect/login.
The graph's L617 SwingWorker target at L1500 belongs to disconnect, so that target is rejected.
ImageCellRenderer has a constructor reference in FavoritesDlg.
ImageCellRenderer has a constructor reference in PreferencesDlg.
Both transferables have explicit constructor calls.
Default FTP implementation and parser class names are stored as strings.
ftpapi 3.0.0 and JavaHelp are declared external dependencies.
